review.draftParagraph: The decline is defensible. A storm is made out on the rainfall limb (27 mm/hr on 28 January 2026, Storm Chandra), but the damage is not storm-consistent: six dated photos show ponding, a sagging deck, an existing bitumen patch and moss, and causation is reasoned, so the covering was already failing and the rain revealed it (compare DRN-4885234). The insurer has discharged its burden. Two carve-outs remain: the 680 GBP emergency tarpaulin the customer paid is likely payable (compare DRN-4997488), and any internal water damage should be considered under accidental damage cover.
